_about: G3 person split (tools/make_split.py plan). NOT a make_context_crops --stratify-json file: that tool draws its own two-way split and would put test people in training (it refuses this format). `people` = every stratified person with its side; `cobra` = every COBRA case with its screen status and side ('hold' = on no side until the screen calls it). Everyone not named here takes the ordinary rule in `rule`; tools/make_split.py apply writes the side of every person and item.

rule.unit: person key (tools/patient_keys.py, folded by make_split apply)
rule.small_inventory_rule: FLAGSHIP_PLAN G3: 'if the inventory is smaller than 150 transitional persons, test takes 50 %'. Read on the whole G1 inventory (194 persons), because its own arithmetic is inventory-level (150 x 0.4 = the 60-person test target); every single subtype is below 150, so a per-subtype reading would make the rule the default.
rule.small_cell: exact largest-remainder allocation per subtype, ties to test then val; 2+ people -> >=1 test, 3+ -> >=1 val (taken from train)
rule.within_subtype_order: (corpus, stratum, hash) dealt in a stride pattern

ordinary.hash: u = int(sha256('g3|<seed>|<key>').hexdigest()[:13], 16) / 16**13; train u<0.8, val u<0.9, else test

cobra.hold_rule: a held case whose hash side is test is in test now; otherwise it is on no side until the screen calls it, then test (transitional / re-read) or side_if_released

rule.merge_precedence: test > hold > val > train (a merged group takes its most held-out member's side)
